scripts.build: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --project tsconfig.json
scripts.test:regular: bun test test/entrypoint.test.ts test/eligibility.test.ts test/transport.test.ts test/event-transport.test.ts test/smoke-harness.test.ts --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:coverage: bun test test/entrypoint.test.ts test/eligibility.test.ts test/transport.test.ts test/event-transport.test.ts test/smoke-harness.test.ts --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov && bun scripts/check-source-coverage.ts 80
